article.title: The girls of Gaza who are being forced into marriage for survival
article.author: Enas Abu Ghayad
article.content: Child marriage in Gaza is surging, with 20.6% of recent marriages involving girls under 18. Amid hunger, displacement, and a collapsed legal system, girls are losing their childhoods to a "protection" that doesn't exist.
source_folders: 06_左派ニュース・社会主義戦略
